summary: All 7 must-have requirements and identified risk mitigations are implemented and verified. Test suite ran 52 tests with 0 failures according to verify_report.json, and no blocking issues exist.

checklist.item: R1: Atomic lifetime click counter increment and timestamp update
checklist.evidence: LinkService.cs in function GetRedirectAsync uses ExecuteUpdateAsync to increment ClickCount and set LastVisitedAtUtc directly in SQLite. Validated by tests in tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs (R1_Redirect_ActiveLinkWithPriorClicks_IncrementsLifetimeClickCountAndSetsLastVisited, R1_Redirect_NonExistentOrExpiredCode_ReturnsNotFound404) and confirmed passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R2: Atomic daily analytics upsert query
checklist.evidence: LinkService.cs in function GetRedirectAsync executes raw SQLite INSERT INTO ShortLinkDailyClicks ... ON CONFLICT(ShortLinkId, Date) DO UPDATE SET Clicks = ShortLinkDailyClicks.Clicks + 1. Validated by tests in tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs (R2_Redirect_FirstVisitOnDate_CreatesDailyRecordWithSingleClick, R2_Redirect_ExistingDailyRecordWithClicksN_UpsertsToNPlusOne) and passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R3: EF Core migration management replacing EnsureCreatedAsync
checklist.evidence: Program.cs calls DatabaseBootstrapper.BootstrapAsync which runs Database.MigrateAsync() instead of EnsureCreatedAsync; InitialCreate.cs provides handwritten initial migration annotated with DbContext and Migration attributes. Validated by test R3_Startup_CleanDatabase_AppliesInitialMigrationAndRecordsInHistory in tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs and passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R4: Automated legacy database upgrade bootstrap
checklist.evidence: DatabaseBootstrapper.cs in function BootstrapAsync detects existing ShortLinks table, executes CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for ShortLinkDailyClicks and __EFMigrationsHistory, seeds initial migration, and runs MigrateAsync within an explicit transaction. Validated by test R4_LegacyDatabase_BootstrapsMissingTablesAndMigrationHistory in tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs and passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R5: Parallel redirect concurrency testing without lost updates
checklist.evidence: tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs defines test R5_Redirect_Concurrent100Requests_AccuratelyIncrementsLifetimeAndDailyClicks issuing 100 parallel requests and verifying exact click counts (100) across both tables. All 52 tests passed in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R6: Legacy database schema upgrade without data loss
checklist.evidence: tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs defines test R6_LegacyDatabase_WithPreExistingLink42Clicks_UpgradesAndIncrementsTo43Clicks which verifies upgrading a legacy database with a pre-existing 42-click link increments to 43 and reports daily analytics successfully. Passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R7: Preservation of existing endpoint API contracts and rate limiting
checklist.evidence: Contract compatibility verified across tests/ShortenEndpointTests.cs, tests/AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs, tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs, and tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs (e.g., R7_RateLimiting_ExceedingThreshold_ReturnsTooManyRequests429WithRetryAfter, R7_Health_WhenOperational_ReturnsOk200). All 52 tests passed in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: Risk: SQLite locking/busy errors during high concurrency
checklist.evidence: DatabaseBootstrapper.cs configures SQLite WAL journal mode and busy_timeout=30000; LinkService.cs defines ExecuteWithRetryAsync and IsSqliteBusy with progressive backoff. Validated by test R5_Redirect_Concurrent100Requests_AccuratelyIncrementsLifetimeAndDailyClicks in tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs and passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: Risk: Partial legacy database upgrade failure leaving inconsistent migration metadata
checklist.evidence: DatabaseBootstrapper.cs in function BootstrapAsync wraps table verification, column renames, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements, and __EFMigrationsHistory seeding within BeginTransactionAsync and CommitAsync before calling Database.MigrateAsync(). Validated by test R4_LegacyDatabase_BootstrapsMissingTablesAndMigrationHistory in tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs and passing in verify_report.json.
